quotes.text: "Throbber should be hidden during the search"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current test_loading_icon waits an autocomplete promise registered before typing, then checks visible and hidden throbber states. Its final hidden assertion still says during the search, despite occurring after completion. Proposed manual writing rule: align failure text with the exact stage under test. This is a justified improvement proposal, not a claim that all accepted messages already follow it. The mutation wait is registered after typing; no timing experiment was run.
title: State the final expected search state in test failure text
